assets.subject: Cross-section front view of a small two-level post-apocalyptic corner shop building at a city crossroads, like a dollhouse with the front wall removed. Top: grey sky and the facade roof line with an empty sign bracket above the entrance. Ground floor, left to right: a closed garage with a rolled-down dented shutter (locked, dim); a storeroom with bare concrete walls; the main shop floor with patched wallpaper, an entrance doorway on its left side; a workshop corner with pegboard wall; an outdoor yard with cracked asphalt and a fence. Below ground: a dark underground shelter level, barely visible, closed off by a heavy hatch, mysterious. Rooms are EMPTY: no furniture, no counter, no shelves, no racks, no workbench, no lamps, no water tank, no sign — those are separate sprites. No people.
assets.extra: Wide 16:10 scene, NOT transparent. Follow the attached layout guide exactly: walls, floors and room borders where the guide boxes are; hatched red areas must stay empty background; do not draw the guide lines, labels or colors. Also attach art/reference/shop_mood.webp as the mood reference: same materials, palette and light, but as a cross-section of the whole building.
